span.p:
can read it,
and you may see it

span.p:
cannot read it, or a
permission is missing

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
You type a question
'What was the revenue for the past 37 days?'

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Signed in, and under
30 questions this hour?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Built-in answerer
reads the topic, dates and ground,
checks what you may see,
and looks it up in your books
(same code as the Reports tab)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
Used only if a key is set and the built-in
answerer cannot read the question.
Claude gets read-only tools for your books.
No customer names, phones or emails are sent.
Up to 6 look-ups. If it fails or times out,
the built-in answerer takes over

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Plain-language answer with the exact dates
and basis used, a few details,
and 'open this report'

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Says so, shows examples or names
the missing permission

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Every rupee amount in the reply
is checked against the tool results

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Marked 'not fully verified',
with the amounts to double-check

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The question (not the answer)
is logged for audit
